Blank theme for circular layouts

Source: R/theme.R
theme_circos.Rd

The default theme of a circular plot: no grid, no axes, sensible margins and a legend on the right. Layer on top of it with + theme() as usual.

Usage

theme_circos(
  bgcolor = "white",
  grid = FALSE,
  axis = FALSE,
  legend.position = "right",
  margin = 10
)

Arguments

bgcolor

Panel background colour. The panel is painted, not left transparent, so that bgcolor = "white" really is white – theme_void() blanks the elements, it does not fill them.

grid

Keep the panel grid? With a circular coordinate these are the polar elements panel.grid.*.theta / panel.grid.*.r, not cartesian .x / .y.

axis

Keep the axes? With a circular coordinate these are axis.text.theta, axis.line.theta, axis.ticks.theta.

legend.position

Legend placement, passed to ggplot2::theme().

margin

Plot margin, in points.

Value

A ggplot2 theme.

Examples

ggcircos(cor(mtcars), order = "hclust") +
    geom_chord() +
    theme_circos(bgcolor = "grey95")
